about: The command line tool for deploying and running apps on Fly.io.

prs.title: Machines made through the AI tools get the right settings
prs.broken: Creating or running a Fly Machine through flyctl's AI assistant tools gave it the wrong start command and the wrong auto-stop setting.
prs.changed: The auto-stop option is now passed in a form the command line reads as one setting.
prs.matters: Machines started by AI assistants run the command the user asked for and stop the way they expect.

prs.title: The AI tool for updating a machine updates it
prs.broken: The AI assistant tool for updating a Fly Machine tried to create a new one instead, and failed. Fixing that alone would have reset start and stop settings on every update.
prs.changed: The tool now runs the update command, only passes the settings the caller gave, and passes the start command too.
prs.matters: AI assistants can change a running machine without breaking it or quietly changing its other settings.

prs.title: Every environment variable reaches the machine
prs.broken: Giving the AI machine tools several environment variables or metadata entries produced one variable with all the values glued together by commas.
prs.changed: Each entry is now passed to the command line on its own.
prs.matters: Machines started by AI assistants get every variable they were given, with the right values.
